6. Janice Marie McCourt | Driving Growth and Excellence in the Biotech and Pharmaceutical Landscape

A C-level executive with over 25 years of expertise in the biotech and pharmaceutical industries, Janice Marie McCourt is the CEO & Board Member at Hudson Therapeutics, the US subsidiary of Shaperon, a South Korean company that develops innovative therapies for orphan and other leading immunology indications. From leading corporate and commercial strategy to investor relations for Hudson Therapeutics, her focus on orphan indications and immunology is leading to successful partnerships and licensing deals, boosting the company’s valuation and expansion in the global market.

Parallely, she leads as the Chief Business Officer, Chief Commercial Officer, Strategic Advisor & Member of the Executive Team at Lyvgen Biopharma. In this role, Janice spearheads corporate strategy, communications, clinical operations, licensing deals, research and development collaborations focused on immunology and antibody platforms focused on immuno-oncology, to name a few.

With a strong background in industrial pharmacy, commercial strategy, finance, and product launch of major global brands, and backed by an MBA, Janice has successfully raised over $8.5 billion in investment and partnering deals throughout her career, alongside partnering with major biotech and pharmaceutical organizations. Additionally, she has built and managed commercial teams and launched blockbuster products in oncology markets and additional therapeutic areas.

Passionate about creating value for patients, shareholders, and partners, Janice Marie McCourt drives growth and innovation in the biotech and pharmaceutical fields.

LinkedIn

7. Scott Longman | Serving Excellence to the People and Businesses of the City of London

A visionary leader, Scott Marcus Longman, is the Director and Owner of Scott Longman City of London Ambassador Ltd. With a strong experience of working in a variety of roles, he aspires to serve and represent the City of London, as its Freemen, and Liverymen efficiently. Alongside his company, Scott is associated with The City Corporation and The Lord Mayor to represent The City of London both in the UK and internationally. Apart from these roles, he also hosts Professional Business Networking events in the City of London.

Among his notable milestones, Scott has been the Freeman of the City of London since 2005, Liveryman of the City of London since 2008, and Ambassador for the City of London since 2012. As a multi-faceted expert, he even hosts International Professional Networking Events, both online and in-person, while being a Public Speaker on 2 educational presentations since 2016. Additionally, he is the founder & CEO of The AIDE Foundation, and founder & Director of The City of London Entrepreneurs Club.

Envisioning the future, Scott plans to stand for election for the Common Council in The City at the next available opportunity, adding a step ahead towards his goal of serving London. And, from 2026, he will hold his own International Business trade Conferences both in the UK and worldwide.

“My desire is be able to serve and represent The City of London, Freemen, Liverymen. and any who is part of it in The City of London and Worldwide, to build a great future for the present and future generations as Freeman, Liveryman and Member of The Freeman of England and Wales and many other City Institutions,” Scott Marcus Longman reflects.

LinkedIn | Instagram | Website | Facebook

8. Dr. Tony McCaffrey | Restoring Hope with Creativity for a Better Future

A visionary and creative leader, Dr. Tony McCaffrey, the co-founder of an innovative platform, BrainSwarm AI, is bringing a pioneering solution to restore hope through creativity.
We live in trying times with so many overwhelming problems facing about the climate, microplastics, AI dominance, etc. This depletes people’s hope in the future.

“Creativity is our world’s only hope,” McCaffrey concludes. “We need a great deal of creativity to invent our way out of these problems.” Unfortunately, current AI in the form of Large Language Models (LLMs) cannot be of much help. He shares, “These models are far from being creative. If you give them creative puzzles whose answers are not on the internet, they cannot solve them. I tested this thoroughly, given that my PhD is in Cognitive Psychology, specializing in creativity and problem solving.”

With his online platform, BrainSwarm AI, Dr. McCaffrey is assembling his students and industry professionals to solve problems together. His students often notice things that the professionals overlook. “Notice what you are overlooking. That is the key to crafting creative solutions,” says McCaffrey. But how do you do that? Fortunately, humans get stuck in very predictable ways. For each way, Dr. McCaffrey has devised a specific method to get us unstuck.

With the tools for enhancing creativity, the platform also has a comic strip superhero, “Captain Sideways,” teaching people to solve problems by showing them how to look at a problem from different angles and notice what has been overlooked. After experiencing an adventure with this superhero, users learn actual techniques to improve their creativity and problem-solving skills, enabling them to apply the techniques in the real world.

With BrainSwarm AI and Captain Sideways, he is bringing people together to solve real-world problems, reigniting hope. Dr. McCaffrey’s comments, “With hope dimming, we need to look deep inside ourselves and into our neighbors to find ways to resuscitate it.”

LinkedIn

9. Nicholas Jackson | Delivering Measurable Impact across Industries

A seasoned global IT executive and transformation leader, Nicholas Jackson brings over two decades of experience driving enterprise-wide ERP programs and digital transformations across manufacturing, chemicals, automotive, consumer goods, and agriculture industries. Recognized for steering multi-million-dollar SAP S/4HANA programs, Nicholas blends deep hands-on expertise with visionary leadership to deliver measurable business outcomes.

As Program Director and Vice President-level leader, Nicholas has directed initiatives spanning the globe. His track record spans large-scale brownfield S/4HANA conversions, global template rollouts across 50+ plants and 70+ company codes, and cutting-edge adoption of SAP BTP, RISE, Signavio, and LeanIX. His approach integrates clean core strategy, master data governance, and process optimization with a relentless focus on adoption, change leadership, and business value realization.

Nicholas is widely regarded for bridging the divide between technology and business outcomes. He has helped Fortune 500 organizations modernize their operations and foster a culture of continuous improvement where digital transformation is treated as a joint responsibility of IT and the business.

Beyond his technical mastery, Nicholas is a passionate leader and storyteller, frequently sharing insights on transformational debt, culture change, and leadership philosophies—drawing inspiration from lessons learned in his father’s small business, his passion for bird-watching, and his love of Star Trek metaphors to guide teams through the emotional highs and lows of ERP journeys.

A trusted advisor to CFOs, CIOs, and executive committees, he is committed to helping organizations unlock innovation, reduce complexity, and future-proof their digital ecosystems. Nicholas Jackson’s leadership philosophy is grounded in accountability, trust, and the belief that “pressure is a privilege” when guiding global teams through transformation.

LinkedIn

10. Daria Mateichenko | Serial Operations Architecting the Rhythm of Business Growth

From co-founding a tech company and scaling it from 3 to 30 people with zero outside investment — growing annual turnover by 500% even through the turbulence of COVID — to mentoring leadership teams across Europe and the U.S., Daria Mateichenko has become known as a Serial Architect of Operations. While many founders dream of escaping operations, her journey began by diving into the heart of businesses, mapping processes, and designing strategies for transformation through building products that fit.

Today Daria leads DM Wings, a consulting agency that blends her 10+ years of operational expertise with AI-powered solutions. Acting as a Fractional COO/PMO, she supports serial entrepreneurs and tech founders in the U.S. and Europe with revenues ranging from $1M to $15M, unlocking up to 30% more delivery capacity while reducing leadership time spent in operations by as much as 25 hours per week.

Daria’s modular growth roadmaps, AI-driven workflow automation, team rhythm systems, and mentoring programs for admins and tactical managers have become a proven playbook for founders who want to scale without chaos.

Looking ahead, Daria’s mission is to rewrite how businesses grow: by freeing entrepreneurs from constant firefighting, designing organizations that empower people instead of burning them out, and using technology as a multiplier of human vision. Beyond business, Daria Mateichenko serves as a board member of the European chapter of the Ukrainian Business Club and is a devoted mother, balancing leadership with raising her daughter — a role she calls her most transformative project.

Conclusion

The 10 leaders transforming business for tomorrow show that leadership is about more than titles. It is about choices, consistency, and care for the people around them. These 10 leaders continue to push boundaries, inspire others, and lead with purpose.
Their success stories are not just about profit—they are about creating value that lasts. As the world changes, their ideas and efforts will guide the next generation toward a smarter and more sustainable future.

title: Are You Afraid to Purchase Bitcoin?  Making Wise Decisions Can be Made Easier by a Little Attention
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: When I initially learned about Bitcoin ten years ago, I said all the dumb things people say when they don’t understand it. I thought it was intended for a dystopian future, which didn’t make any sense to me at all. So, I was saying things like, “But if there’s an apocalypse and there’s no Internet, how would anyone access their Bitcoin anyway?” while the intelligent people were purchasing an entire Bitcoin for only a few hundred US dollars. It wasn’t until last week that I saw someone had posted the concerning statement, “Hackers hijack npm packages in what is being called the largest supply chain hack in history,” on my crypto group. Malware” and “malicious code,” two of my new least favourite terms, were explained to us as meaning that they could be diverted, or stolen and gone forever. Additionally, I received a brief instruction on the distinction between a “hack” and an “exploit.” ‬ The first obtains unauthorized access to a system, whereas the second—the one we were addressing exploits an existing weakness in a system. Naturally, my first impulse was to check on all of my cryptocurrency and secure it in some way, but because I knew there was nothing I could do, I went to bed. 1. Dr. Peter Kronen | Empowering Safe Anaesthesia in Veterinary Treatments

Today, VASTA is among the leading names as a Veterinary Anaesthesia School around the world.

Most veterinary personnel, including veterinarians, nurses, and technicians, receive only a minimal anaesthesia education and training during their professional education.

In most cases, undergoing specialty training is impossible for veterinary personnel due to workload, cost, or even geographical constraints. To solve this issue, VASTA by Dr. Kronen offers clinically meaningful, up-to-date knowledge and skills to veterinary personnel from renowned experts in the field, in many geographical regions. At the same time, with this initiative, veterinary clinics gain a direct competitive advantage from training their personnel in this important field.

With a 1-year programme, participants receive a profound knowledge and skill package, allowing them to safely and comfortably anaesthetize the vast majority of clinically relevant patients with different diseases and health statuses. With his relentless efforts and dedication, Dr. Kronen has established VASTA as a pioneering veterinary education provider, with over 1100 graduates globally. Reshaping the way anaesthesia is applied in veterinary medicine in the regions, Dr. Peter Kronen operates VASTA as a major contributor to anaesthetic safety in the veterinary landscape, while reducing fear of anaesthesia for pet owners alike.

With a commitment to increasing the desirability of brands and leaving behind a positive impact, Stanislas de Quercize is a well-acclaimed and influential figure in the luxury industry.

3. Redefining Logistics and Empowering the African Continent | Capt. Pappu Sastry

In the ever-evolving logistics landscape, which plays an instrumental role in the global economy, leaders like Capt. Pappu Sastry are driving the industry forward. A visionary figure in the logistics sector, Capt. Pappu Sastry is the CEO of ADHIRA Shipping & Logistics (ASL), a renowned name in the field exceeding mining logistics requirements. With over 25 years of in-depth knowledge of Shipping and expertise of the African logistics landscape, Capt. Sastry is acclaimed for his unwavering dedication to enhancing the continent’s logistical capabilities.

Driven by a deep understanding of the challenges and potential in the logistics sector of the African continent, Capt. Sastry embarked on a journey to transform the setbacks into breakthrough opportunities. His commitment to innovative economical solutions is reflected in ASL’s investment in structures and procedures, ensuring enhanced supply chain visibility, optimizing efficiencies, and timely deliveries, alongside offering unparalleled services to clients.

Sastry is associated as an advisor to the boards of several renowned companies, including Legacy Group, Empower Capital, Critical Investments, and Africa Bulk Shipping. With numerous recognitions and honours, he has been certified as “Certified CEO” by the CEO Institute, Australia, in 2023 and “Certified Chair” by the Advisory Board Center, Australia, in 2025. Additionally, he has received several awards, including the “Bulk Logistics Excellence Award” at the IBJ Awards in Antwerp 2024 and London 2023, and “Entrepreneur of the Year” in the Netherlands in 2022.

By driving economic development for Africa through business as the medium, Capt. Pappu Sastry proves that along with strengthening the local ecosystem, leaders like him can even profoundly impact the socio-economic growth and development of an entire continent.

4. Dr. Sofica Bistriceanu | A Dynamic Healthcare Expert, Researcher, and Poetess

Dr. Sofica Bistriceanu, MD, Ph.D., a skilled family physician, has extensive experience in healthcare. She graduated from Iasi University in Romania and completed family medicine research at Maastricht University. She has participated in numerous meetings worldwide. With over 120 presentations internationally and more than 50 articles published in international journals, she has earned several awards.

Dr. Sofica Bistriceanu is also a member of the Academy for Professionalism in Healthcare and serves on the Editorial Review Board for The Journal of Patient Experience (JPX), the Editorial Board of the Journal of Medical Research and Clinical Case Reports – Research Portal Central Publishers. Additionally, she serves as an Associate Editor for Primera Scientific Publication and represents the Academic Medical Unit – CMI Dr. Bistriceanu, S., in NT, ROU. Reflecting her literary and creative expertise, Dr. Bistriceanu has also authored seven volumes of poetry, published by Cronica, and Time, both from Iasi Publishing House.

Her research focuses on how communication styles influence people’s lives, including their health. She highlights the harmful effects of improper interactions, both in person and online, on overall well-being and balance. She underscored that Inappropriate verbal and nonverbal communication can lead to conditions such as arterial hypertension, type 2 diabetes, dyslipidemia, obesity, other endocrine disorders, and even brain hemorrhages or tumors in vulnerable individuals. Paying attention to communication skills is crucial in daily interactions.

Since poor communication is a risk factor for various physical and mental health issues, being polite is essential. It is the most cost-effective way to prevent serious diseases and reduce healthcare costs. Additionally, she has emphasized that building and maintaining honest and respectful relationships with customers, along with a friendly attitude toward them, enhances their collaborative work and lives. Client loyalty reflects the provider’s offerings, including product quality, availability when needed, reasonable prices, effective communication, sharing the presence well, as well as a good name.

With notable contributions to healthcare and research, Dr. Sofica Bistriceanu is committed to advancing medical knowledge and inspiring the next generation of healthcare professionals and leaders.

LinkedIn

5. Maria Sergeeva | Redefining Health Data Management

From clinical psychology to global advocacy, from data journalism to technology leadership and non-profit entrepreneurship, Maria Sergeeva’s career has always revolved around one central thread: making information usable to drive change. Whether amplifying unheard voices through data journalism, designing PR campaigns grounded in analytics, founding mission-driven organisations, or writing hundreds of GP letters to bridge communication gaps in healthcare as part of her patient and neurodiversity advocacy, Maria has consistently worked at the intersection of data, impact, and human stories.

That mission became deeply personal when she realised she could not bring her own health data together in one place—across languages, countries, providers, and countless apps that often added to the fragmentation. She also noticed that the patients she was advocating for were drowning in information without ever being able to make their data usable. In 2019, Maria built a simple solution to manage her own records and those of people she was supporting, convinced that a comprehensive tool for users must already be on its way.

When she moved countries again in 2021, Maria discovered just how wrong that assumption was. Through research, conversations with professors, clinicians, and founders, she realised that the reason no solution existed was structural: systems were never built to give patients ownership for many reasons, and their privacy would hardly be the priority. If it was going to change, she would have to build it herself.

That insight led to the creation of Health Data Avatar (HDA), the platform Maria founded to finally give patients a multilingual, cross-border digital health twin to use their data on their terms. By turning scattered files, handwritten and personal notes, and records into structured, searchable, and shareable data with multiple privacy options, HDA enables patients to take control of their health story in any language, avoid dangerous medication overlaps, prevent unnecessary repeat tests, and make prevention and care more accessible.

Looking ahead, she is determined to establish a new global standard for personal health data ownership: one where patients are not passive record holders, but active agents of change whose stories drive better care and more equitable systems worldwide.

LinkedIn | Website

6. Reimagining Human Connection in a Disconnected World | Olga Ploke

A bold and influential voice in the global movement to combat loneliness, Olga Ploke is pioneering innovative solutions to one of the 21st century’s most urgent yet overlooked social challenges. As Founder and CEO of adandra, a human-centered digital platform nurturing intergenerational connections and empowering “chosen families,” she spearheads a paradigm shift in how we design community, care, and belonging.

Olga’s journey is deeply personal as well as visionary. Born in Ukraine and raised without a traditional family network, she later moved to Germany navigating the challenges of single motherhood and caring for her mobility-impaired mother. These experiences gave her profound insight into the isolating gaps permeating modern society. Her yearning for connection was not only emotional but fundamentally structural. This intimate understanding, combined with her international academic and professional background, ignited the vision behind adandra.

Holding a BA in Linguistics from Belarus and dual Master’s degrees, an MPA and MBA, from the American University in Washington, D.C., Olga brings a globally informed, systems-thinking approach to social innovation. Her career spans complex roles in government and nonprofit organizations such as the US Information Service in Belarus, International Republican Institute in the USA, and Scottish Development International in Germany, along with business development at Ernst&Young, where she worked for over 13 years. Yet, at heart, she remains devoted to community-driven impact.

At the intersection of technology and empathy, adandra embodies Olga’s solution to a fragmented world. The platform leverages ethically developed technology for personalized matching and integrates self-reflection and communication tools that help people cultivate lasting, meaningful bonds — what Olga calls “a structural response to loneliness.”

But adandra is far more than a product; it is a social movement. Under Olga’s leadership, it is redefining family, community, and care in an era where millions suffer in silence. She has emerged as a powerful advocate for social inclusion, emotional well-being, and digital innovation that genuinely serves humanity. As one of today’s most influential new voices shaping the future of human connection, Olga Ploke reminds the world that empathy, thoughtful design, and courageous leadership can heal even the most invisible epidemics.

LinkedIn | Instagram | Website 

7. Anita Mendiratta | Leading With Vision: Inspiring Global Impact With Courage and Compassion

Global strategic advisor, diplomat, author, and on-air and on-stage personality Anita Mendiratta’s career is a rare blend of corporate mastery, entrepreneurial vision, and deeply human leadership. Her unique journey began in the dynamic corridors of IBM, Unilever, and The Coca-Cola Company, international corporate powerhouses that shaped her strategic acumen and anchored her ability to lead across cultures. Building on this foundation and with a commitment to translating vision into genuine action, she created ANITA MENDIRATTA & ASSOCIATES, a London-based management consultancy renowned for enabling strategic leadership. With an acute understanding of the economic, social, cultural, and environmental factors shaping and reshaping nations and industries, over three decades, she has advised over 100 countries, becoming a trusted confidante to world leaders, CEOs, and global institutions in the establishment clear, compelling, united and competitive economies, societies and identities, particularly in the areas of sustainable development through tourism and aviation. Most recently, and as the world rebuilds and reshapes post-pandemic yet in the face of significant ongoing challenges including the climate crisis and geo-political conflict, Anita works closely with leaders guiding them through transformation, and importantly, crisis, with clarity, courage, and care.

Furthermore, as the long-established and globally trusted Special Advisor to the Secretary General of UN Tourism, Anita plays an active role in shaping the global leadership landscape, providing counsel pivotal to national advancement and competitiveness, particularly across the Middle East, Asia, and Africa where she has helped governments and industries leverage these sectors as engines of economic growth, societal development, and international standing.

Her evolution from corporate executive to globally trusted thought leader and confidante has been defined as a voice that is authoritative and deeply relatable. A go-to for global media including AlJazeera, BBC, Bloomberg, CNBC, France24, Sky News, and TRT World, Anita is recognised for distilling complex realities into clear, actionable insight, often in moments of global uncertainty. Her multi-award-nominated book, “The Call to Leadership,” has resonated worldwide as a landmark work on courage, vision, and the human side of decision-making during times of crisis. A familiar presence on UN, IATA, WTTC, and other global stages, she has brought a unique richness of perspective, earning her recognition among the “Most Influential Women in Tourism” and “Top 25 Executives to Watch.”

At the heart of Anita’s leadership is a conviction that influence must be matched by impact which she brings to life through The Anita Mendiratta Foundation (AMF), channelling her expertise and networks into uplifting vulnerable communities, particularly in crisis-hit, tourism-dependent nations. Focused on education and economic sustainability, AMF projects are committed to building futures of dignity and hope.

Anita Mendiratta’s path is one of uncommon depth – an arc that seamlessly connects corporate success, entrepreneurial leadership, global influence, and purposeful philanthropy, proving that the most resonant leadership is that which blends strategy with humanity, and achievement with service.

LinkedIn | AMF | Website

8. Sarjan Ram | Pioneering Creativity and Innovation Across Industries

A seasoned professional and an innovator, Sarjan Ram is the founder and Creative Director of Beach Haus, a City of London–based consultancy and cultural brand that operates at the edge of art, branding, creative, hospitality, and technology. Originally launched as a disruptive gallery concept, Beach Haus has evolved into a high-concept consultancy uniting creative strategy, avant-garde expression, and socially conscious design. Its themes: purpose over popularity, disruption across multiple verticals, and AI-enabled guest experiences, reflect Sarjan’s vision for businesses that balance creativity, commerce, and community. He describes Beach Haus as his intellectual and creative platform, integrated on truth, and designed to disrupt. It is a cultural and intellectual project that mixes the old world with the new, carried forward by a long-term independent vision.

With a distinguished corporate career, Sarjan has delivered multi-million-pound innovations and led global strategy projects across industries, including food, beverage, nutrition, and ingredients. His experience spans enterprise-level programmes in brand building, analytics, consumer insight, M&A integrations, cross-channel marketing, geographic expansion, and corporate innovation strategy. 

Parallelly, as a creative spanning design, interior, advertising, music, artistic and literature, in his own right, Beach Haus has enabled Sarjan to fully integrate his curation and artistic side into his professional practice. With Beach Haus, he has created an MVP concept that blends cutting-edge creative agency work with a gallery-led guest stay retail model—a pioneering move that is premiumising the experiential guest stay market. As one of the earliest innovators in this space, Sarjan positioned Beach Haus years ahead of its time. Under his strategic direction and vision, Beach Haus has become a multi-award-winning ecosystem that crosses different industry verticals and ways of working, collaborating with leading artists—including talent represented by Tate Modern and Saatchi, while earning recognition for disruptive innovation in the gallery and contemporary art space. 

From boutique hospitality destinations like Gensing Lodge and Florence of Oxford to AI-powered storytelling and cross-sector collaborations, Sarjan Ram is redefining what it means to build globally connected, culturally disruptive, and ethically future-facing businesses. 

LinkedIn | Website 

9. Chris Hughes | Simplifying International Payments with a Redefined Travel Card

Chris Hughes has built his career at the heart of fintech’s most transformative moments, from helping architect financial systems at Revolut during its hypergrowth, to leading core products at Tamara as the Gulf’s fintech scene accelerated. His contribution has consistently been at the intersection of finance, technology, and execution: designing the infrastructure that makes complex financial products simple and accessible for end-users. As the Founder and CEO of Sinder, he is bringing this experience to bear by building the UAE’s first 0% FX markup debit card, underpinned by Shariah compliance and a premium customer experience. 

His vision for Sinder is rooted in solving real, local problems while setting a global standard for design and transparency. The Gulf is the world’s highest-value outbound travel market, yet its financial services remain a decade behind Europe and the US. By focusing on travel-centric money, cards, wallets, remittance, and connectivity services like eSIM, Chris aims to close that gap and create a borderless experience for global citizens living in the UAE. Sinder’s mission is to simplify international payments and empower expats, students, and frequent travelers with transparent, tech-forward financial tools.

Looking ahead, he sees fintech evolving toward hyper-localisation and commoditisation: financial services delivered at near-zero cost, tailored precisely to customer needs. Chris Hughes’ ambition is not just to launch another card, but to build a platform that empowers UAE residents to move, spend, and connect globally without friction, proving that the region can be a birthplace for world-class fintech innovation. 

LinkedIn | Website

10. Sasa Pejic | A Guide to the Field of Investment

A visionary investor and financial advisor, Sasa Pejic currently leads as the Co-founder and CEO of Pannon GroupNS, a finance consulting and investment advisory service provider. With over two decades of expertise as an investor and financial advisor, Sasa has been offering his knowledge and counseling services throughout his career path. Apart from his current endeavours, Sasa is also a serial entrepreneur, successfully building and selling several startups. 

With years of experience in the financial landscape, Sasa has been helping build predictable cash flow, educate on investment forms, design tailored investment strategies, and apply investment strategies. Committed to staying ahead of the curve, Sasa has added several licenses and certificates to his professional experience, equipping him with additional skills and field knowledge. Furthermore, mentoring in the banking sector helped him hone his leadership, strategic, and decision-making skills, empowering Sasa to pursue entrepreneurial ventures. 

Apart from his professional endeavours, Sasa is deeply committed to serving his community. With a strong belief that individual progress is a result of supporting the community, he has led several initiatives to introducing chess to primary schools fostering critical thinking in children, alongside organizing some of the first online chess tournaments over 15 years ago as the secretary of his local club. 

At Pannon GroupNS, Sasa offers tailored consulting services in the finance and investments sector. With unmatched financing, investment, and corporate restructuring services, the group is revolutionizing the landscape, emerging as a trusted partner in the field. Committed to filling the gap in the industry, Sasa Pejic brings a fresh approach to the field and finance education, playing a crucial role in setting the group apart from the competition in the field.

A New Destination for Timeless Luxury

Set in the heart of Dubai Gold Souk, the upcoming showroom aims to redefine the shopping experience by offering a seamless blend of Swiss-standard watchmaking, Middle Eastern heritage, and world-class jewellery, all under one roof.

Through his partnership with Ilias Mesetzian, James is introducing GW Golden Watches to the UAE for the first time, with plans to expand its presence across Hong Kong, Singapore, and broader Asia in the near future.

The space is currently under development, with design and curation underway to ensure every element reflects the brand’s ethos of exclusivity, trust, and elegance.

Backed by Visionary Leadership: HE Datuk Yuro TY

The project is fully financed and strategically supervised by HE Datuk Yuro TY, James TY’s father and a global business leader whose legacy spans gold and diamond mining, jewellery and bullion distribution, crypto and online gold trading, real estate, and technology ventures.

As the CEO of Tri-T Group and NEST CAPITAL Partners HK Ltd, Datuk Yuro TY has played a pivotal role in bringing this vision to life — ensuring that the foundation of the business is grounded in integrity, quality, and generational continuity.

“It’s not just about opening a showroom — it’s about nurturing vision and building legacy,” says Datuk Yuro TY. “James is stepping into a global market with confidence, and I’m proud to support him on this journey.”

A Family Legacy Expands

The TY family has long been trusted players in the gold and diamond industry, with operations spanning mining, sourcing, and global distribution. With the upcoming opening of the Dubai showroom, they are set to offer customers a holistic luxury experience, featuring:

  • Premium European luxury watches
  • Curated gold jewellery collections

All under the GW Golden Watches brand, led by James TY and supported by his father’s seasoned experience and international network.

Coming Soon to Dubai Gold Souk

The launch of this new showroom marks a significant step forward for both James TY and the TY family business empire, as they combine heritage and innovation to serve the next generation of luxury consumers across the Middle East and Asia.

title: During President Sheikh Mohamed’s Visit, the UAE and Russia Deepen their Strategic Cooperation
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: The UAE and Russia’s strategic alliance has advanced significantly since President Sheikh Mohamed’s formal visit to Moscow. The two leaders discussed expanding cooperation in key areas, including the economy, commerce, investment, space, and energy, during their meeting at the Kremlin with Russian President Vladimir Putin. The leaders discussed the development of UAE-Russian ties, which are based on more than 50 years of respect and trust between the two countries. According to the state news agency Wam, the visit, which started on Thursday and ended on Friday, resulted in the signing of the Trade in Services and Investment Agreement (TISIA), which aims to strengthen the two nations’ economic connections. Financial technology, healthcare, transportation, logistics, and professional services are among the important industries covered by the pact. The TISIA expands upon the UAE’s current economic alliance with the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU), which is made up of Russia and other members such as Kyrgyzstan, Belarus, Kazakhstan, and Armenia. Suhail Mohamed Al Mazrouei, the UAE’s Minister of Energy and Infrastructure, and Andrey Nikitin, the Russian Minister of Transport, signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on land transport cooperation in addition to the TISIA. Many people believe that Dame Stella, who led the security agency from 1992 to 1996, served as the inspiration for Dame Judi Dench’s character M in the James Bond movies. She began working for MI5 full-time in 1969, and after serving as deputy director general in 1991, she was elevated to director general the following year. Following her retirement from the military, Dame Stella started working as a novelist. She died surrounded by her beloved family and dogs and resolutely held on to the life she loved until her last breath,” her family said in a statement. As the first director general to be publicly named upon appointment, Dame Stella and her family were forced to relocate to a secret place for their safety after a newspaper published a picture of her home. As the first female head of any intelligence agency in history to be officially acknowledged, his predecessor “broke through long-standing barriers and was a visible example of the importance of diversity in leadership,” said current MI5 director general Sir Ken McCallum in a tribute. She began her professional journey at global banks in Jordan and steadily climbed the ranks in this field with passion and enthusiasm. She reflects, “Success doesn’t come from what you do occasionally; it comes from what you do consistently.”

In 2018, Dina moved to Geneva to join the Global Wealth Management division at UBS Bank; the largest asset manager in Switzerland. During her time at UBS, she was certified as a Wealth Management Advisor by the SAQ Swiss Association for Quality. She was also nominated by UBS Bank’s management as a financial ambassador to the Middle East, a role in which she led and empowered women in finance.

As a UBS Ambassador, Dina played a crucial role in women’s empowerment in finance, helping women enhance their financial confidence and decision-making. She also worked on educating women in the Middle East on managing their assets, investing wisely, diversifying their portfolios, and optimizing asset allocation to meet their financial needs.

After a successful and fulfilling tenure at UBS Switzerland, Dina transitioned into entrepreneurship, joining Woodman Asset Management as an external asset manager. Woodman is recognized as one of the top 50 wealth managers in Switzerland. As a wealth management entrepreneur, Dina continues to work with determination and dedication toward her clients’ and company’s goals.

3. Mark Coetzee | Transforming Businesses across Continents

Mark Coetzee affectionately known as “MC” by his colleagues—is a visionary thought leader and the dynamic CEO of MC³ International, a global business transformation firm dedicated to empowering organizations on their journey to sustainable growth and innovation. He also serves as Chairman of EarCandy, Africa’s premier media and entertainment localization company, offering end-to-end solutions that bridge cultures and audiences through tailored content.

With a remarkable career spanning over 35 years, Mark has held numerous senior executive and board-level positions across the globe. His expertise in navigating organizations—ranging from ambitious startups to global conglomerates—through periods of significant change and transformation has earned him recognition as a strategic powerhouse in international business leadership.

Mark’s hands-on experience spans five continents and a wide range of industries, with core expertise in growth strategy, mergers and acquisitions, and international expansion. He has been instrumental in three successful corporate exits in recent years, a testament to his ability to deliver exceptional outcomes in high-stakes environments. Known for his results-driven leadership, Mark excels in formulating bold strategies, revitalizing performance, and leading impactful turnarounds in complex, multicultural settings.

As a respected speaker and educator, Mark has inspired business leaders and future change-makers through his talks on Strategy Execution, Performance Excellence, and Customer-Centric Innovation. His thought leadership was recognized globally when he received the International Global Leadership Award at the 2024 Canadian Staffing Summit.

In addition to holding several international certifications, Mark is a Fellow of the Institute of Consulting (UK), a Fellow of the Recruitment & Employment Confederation (UK), and a Member and Assessor at the Institute for Turnaround (UK & Asia). He is also Certified Master Business Coach and contributes as a Council Member and with The Institute of Management Consultants & Master Coaches of South Africa.

Beyond the boardroom, Mark brings the same passion and intensity to his personal pursuits. A dedicated music enthusiast, he collects vinyl records—especially in the genres of Heavy Metal and Hard Rock—and is a proud supporter of Liverpool FC and the Springboks. His eclectic interests include a love for Star Trek, and the offbeat humor of Gary Larson’s Far Side cartoons, reflecting a personality that is both grounded and delightfully unique.

With a rare blend of strategic acumen, cultural fluency, and personal charisma, Mark Coetzee continues to inspire transformation—not just in businesses, but in the lives of those he leads and mentors around the world.

4. Ramadoss Rammohan | A Seasoned Culinary Professional

Ramadoss Rammohan, also known as Chef Ram, is a seasoned culinary expert with a rich background in the hospitality industry. His journey began with a graduation in Culinary Arts in India, which laid a strong foundation for his successful career. He started his professional journey with the prestigious Taj group of Hotels, where he honed his skills and gained valuable experience. Reflecting on his career, Chef Ram shares, “My journey in Kuwait started with the flagship property of Nino Seaside, where I served as the Executive Chef for many years.”

Today, with over two decades of cross-cultural experience, Ramadoss Rammohan leads as the Head of Culinary and Research and Development at Oxygen Gyms, applying his culinary expertise in a new and innovative way. His role is crucial in transforming the food and beverage offerings at Oxygen Gyms, aligning them with the wellness-driven environment of the gym.

One of Chef Ram’s core beliefs is the integration of technology to streamline operations. He highlights the role of tech in optimizing culinary processes, stating, “Technology has made every part of our process foolproof. For instance, we upload recipes into digital weighing scales, and any variation made by the staff is automatically notified in the handles, making it easier for us to standardize everything.”

Chef Ram envisions the food and beverage division at Oxygen Gyms as a vital element of a next-generation wellness and lifestyle ecosystem. “My vision is for food to become an intrinsic and critical part of the wellness space at Oxygen Gyms,” he explains. “Workout spaces won’t just be places for exercise anymore; they are evolving into full-time lifestyle hubs. Apart from personalized meal plans tied to fitness data, we aim to introduce on-demand meal prep services, integrated with a gym app in the future.” He also emphasizes the importance of post-workout recovery drinks, collagen-infused beverages, and anti-inflammatory snacks, all which are already part of the gym’s offerings.

His passion for the field has earned Chef Ram several recognitions, including being the winner of “Nestle Chef Of The Year, 2007.” At present, he is associated as a Judge in a South Indian cooking show “Top Cooku Dupe Cooku.”

Looking ahead, Chef Ram envisions a future where Oxygen Gyms will feature healthy cafés and juice bars that not only promote community but also serve as remote workspaces. This vision reflects his commitment to making the gym a “third place” between work and home, where members can live a holistic lifestyle.

Mark Hagans is a seasoned healthcare strategist and Pharmacy Account Manager with over two decades of leadership driving performance, partnerships, and operational growth across complex healthcare landscapes. With a career rooted in both frontline impact and executive collaboration, Mark has developed a reputation for optimizing pharmacy programs, navigating regulatory frameworks, and delivering sustainable value for health systems and provider networks.

Currently managing high-value accounts at Nuvem, a national healthcare firm, Mark brings a unique blend of business acumen, pharmacy expertise, and relationship-building that translates to real-world outcomes. His deep knowledge of 340B strategy, reimbursement models, and patient access initiatives positions him as a trusted advisor to executives and care teams alike. Whether managing multi-site rollouts or advising on cross-functional solutions, Mark leads with purpose, precision, and a relentless drive to innovate.

Beyond healthcare, Mark is also the Founder and Creative Director of Jus Make Ya Marc—a globally inspired fashion brand rooted in culture, authenticity, and bold self-expression. With extensive knowledge of the fashion industry and diverse skill sets, he leads the company towards innovation and growth. Right from the inception of the brand, Mark has played a crucial role in shaping its success.

Mark Hagans’ entrepreneurial work in brand development reflects a global mindset and the belief that leadership transcends industries when it’s grounded in vision and impact.

Linkedin | Website

6. Alex Ioiskevich | Leading Humanity into the Quantum Age of Space Exploration

As the Founder and CEO of Quantum Propulsion Technologies Ltd, Alex Ioiskevich is pioneering a transformative leap in aerospace technology. His company is at the forefront of developing quantum propulsion systems and next-generation spacecraft that promise to reshape the future of air and space travel. With extensive experience in aerospace and electronic engineering, Alex is a visionary entrepreneur dedicated to redefining the aerospace field. With a mission rooted in innovation, sustainability, and exploration, his group of pioneers envisions a world where interstellar travel is not science fiction—but a tangible, near-future reality.

At the heart of Quantum Propulsion Technologies is a diverse team of engineers, scientists, and visionaries driven by a shared goal: to deliver the ultimate tool for space exploration. The company’s breakthroughs in Hyper-Relativistic Local-Dynamic Space Motion, also known as Quantum Bubble Motion, have led to the development of propulsion systems that defy conventional limitations. These systems offer unprecedented speed, maneuverability, and radiation protection, all while being completely emission-free.

Unlike traditional chemical-fuel engines that pollute and are cost-prohibitive, quantum propulsion systems promise clean, sustainable, and cost-efficient alternatives. Their ability to dramatically lower the cost-per-kilogram of space launches—by factors of hundreds—opens the door to industrial-scale space mining, planetary colonization, and deep space commercial ventures.

Quantum spacecraft, under Alex’s leadership, are being engineered not just to travel farther and faster, but to fundamentally alter how humanity engages with the cosmos. With a clear roadmap and a prototype already unlocking the practical design secrets of quantum engines, Alex Ioiskevich stands as a leading figure in ushering in the next era of spacefaring civilization. His bold vision isn’t just technological—it’s civilizational: to free humanity from the constraints of Earth-bound propulsion and launch us into a new chapter of interstellar destiny.

7. Jaidin McCann | Empowering Leaders and Purpose-Driven Growth

 

From building an entire HR department from scratch for a startup hotel straight out of college to co-founding six startups—including three of her own, Jaidin McCann has carved a path defined by bold leadership, people-centered strategy, and entrepreneurial grit. Her career spans industries and stages, but her mission has always remained the same: to help unlock people’s full potential by building companies and cultures where people are not just employed, but inspired. As a sought-after advisor to tech startups, she’s become the go-to expert for people and talent strategy, guiding founders on how to scale responsibly, lead with heart, and create magnetic cultures that attract top talent and ignite purpose.

Now as the President of myTOD, a mission-driven talent acquisition firm, they are redefining what it means to recruit with purpose. Beyond helping companies hire elite talent, myTOD is leading a movement to impact 10,000 disadvantaged youth, mobilizing a national network of HR leaders to give back using their skills, networks, and influence.

Simultaneously, as a co-founder and board member of Lemonaid, she’s helping architect a first-of-its-kind executive ecosystem—one that empowers leaders to elevate one another through shared opportunity, cross-sector collaboration, and purpose-driven growth.

Owning to her exceptional performance, Jaidin has earned several recognitions and honors in her field, including the recently received Business Leadership Excellence Award by CXO 2.0. With a passion for supporting founders in achieving their dreams and a vision for building workplaces where people love to work, Jaidin McCann is not only setting the pace for 2025; she’s building the future of leadership itself.

LinkedIn | myTOD | Lemonaid

8. Javier Pérez |  Revolutionizing the User Experience on Streaming TV Services

A Spanish serial entrepreneur for over 11 years, Javier Pérez is the Founder of Bubbo, a platform to explore new streaming content, with personalized recommendations for s. After graduating in Sports Science from the European University at 22 and completing a Master’s degree in Marketing and Communication, Javier created his first company, Fútbol Indoor Zaragoza, a pioneering and nationally renowned indoor 5-a-side football facility. Eventually, after four years as a Founding Partner, he exited the company, selling it to two other partners to create his own digital marketing agency, Perseo, with which he has developed more than 400 projects in web design, e-commerce, audiovisual production, online marketing, and branding.

In 2022, he founded Bubbo with an attractive and innovative value proposition and the goal of solving a burning problem in the entertainment industry: confusion in streaming content. Javier shares, “The waste of time caused by indecision when having access to a vast array of content was frustrating for users. Bubbo was born with the vision of transforming consumer behavior and habits by allowing users to discover the content they love in seconds.”

With a vision to transform the way users explore fresh streaming content, Bubbo provides recommendations based on the user’s taste and preferences, saving time in choosing what to watch. The global prop-tech company has now introduced Best Student Stays (BSS) that will operate alongside Best Student Halls (BSH). Students can now find a range of tailored housing options from upscale student halls to budget-friendly rentals. Best Student Living launched its flagship brand, Best Student Halls, in 2013. Over the years, Best Student Halls has emerged as a global leader offering purpose-built student accommodation across the UK, Australia, Europe and the UAE. The brand became synonymous with luxury, offering premium living experiences and high-end rooms. The tech-based platform connects students to elite housing providers renowned for their comprehensive services and student-centric amenities. The launch of Best Student Stays offers more variety, allowing students to choose from an untapped market of housing providers. The focus is on safety and affordability, which is a recurring request from many students. Best Student Stays bridges the gap with affordable student rentals, including houses in multiple-occupancy (HMO) settings, hostels, and shared flats. This digital marketplace for student rentals allows students to customise their search not just by price but also by lifestyle and preference. “Our aim has always been to empower students and enrich their lives”, says Owen Dixon, Founder and Managing Director of Best Student Living. “We believe that housing is an integral part of the student living experience. Best Student Stays ensures that students enjoy safety and comfort even if they are on a budget.” The housing portfolio at Best Student Living is extensive, comprising over 2 million beds in more than 250 cities worldwide. The company now specialises in diverse student housing options, from the all-inclusive and luxury services of Purpose-Built Student Accommodation to safe and affordable HMOs, flats and hostels. With a worldwide presence and a commitment to student living, the company has successfully helped over 32,000 students find their dream room. content:
Best Student Stays Launch Explores an Untapped Market

Best Student Living (BSL), an industry giant in student housing, has recently expanded its housing portfolio. The global prop-tech company has now introduced Best Student Stays (BSS) that will operate alongside Best Student Halls (BSH). Students can now find a range of tailored housing options from upscale student halls to budget-friendly rentals.

Best Student Living launched its flagship brand, Best Student Halls, in 2013. Over the years, Best Student Halls has emerged as a global leader offering purpose-built student accommodation across the UK, Australia, Europe and the UAE. The brand became synonymous with luxury, offering premium living experiences and high-end rooms. The tech-based platform connects students to elite housing providers renowned for their comprehensive services and student-centric amenities.

The launch of Best Student Stays offers more variety, allowing students to choose from an untapped market of housing providers. The focus is on safety and affordability, which is a recurring request from many students. Best Student Stays bridges the gap with affordable student rentals, including houses in multiple-occupancy (HMO) settings, hostels, and shared flats. This digital marketplace for student rentals allows students to customise their search not just by price but also by lifestyle and preference.

“Our aim has always been to empower students and enrich their lives”, says Owen Dixon, Founder and Managing Director of Best Student Living. “We believe that housing is an integral part of the student living experience. Best Student Stays ensures that students enjoy safety and comfort even if they are on a budget.”

The housing portfolio at Best Student Living is extensive, comprising over 2 million beds in more than 250 cities worldwide. The company now specialises in diverse student housing options, from the all-inclusive and luxury services of Purpose-Built Student Accommodation to safe and affordable HMOs, flats and hostels. With a worldwide presence and a commitment to student living, the company has successfully helped over 32,000 students find their dream room.

Explore the collection of fully-furnished student rentals at unbeatable prices with Best Student Stays!

title: Major Records Set During the 2025 Indian Premier League
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: Tuesday, June 3, marked the conclusion of the 2025 Indian Premier League (IPL) as RCB defeated Punjab Kings by six runs in the final, which was held at Ahmedabad’s Narendra Modi Stadium. For the first time in eighteen years, RCB won the IPL title after successfully defending 190 runs in the summit battle. title: Met Gala 2025: The Most Stunning Red Carpet Ensembles
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: As the annual Met Gala began Monday night, the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York came alive with celebrations of Black history, culture, and fashion. The rain didn’t dampen the mood on fashion’s big night out. A-list celebrities from the entertainment, sports, and art industries joined designers, models, and stylists as they climbed the Met’s famous, and for the evening, blue-carpeted, steps. The Costume Institute’s companion exhibition, “Superfine: Tailoring Black Style,” which examines the history of Black dandyism, inspired this year’s much-awaited dress code, “Tailored for You.” According to the Met, the purpose of its yearly theme is to “provide guidance and invite creative interpretation. Both were accomplished, as several guests gave zoot suits—wide-shouldered, high-waisted suits made popular by African American males in the 1940s—a modern twist. Fashion designer Dapper Dan told CNN that “real dandyism” started with zoot suits, jazz, and the Harlem Renaissance movement before he arrived at the event. “That’s when Black creatives and artists started dressing how they felt,” he continued. This year, the first-ever menswear-focused Met Gala dress code was implemented, pushing designers to reinvent tailoring customs for their female clientele. Exaggerated suiting was all over the red carpet, from the wide shoulders of Doja Cat’s Marc Jacobs blazer, which was inspired by the 1980s, to the wide-lapeled jackets worn by rapper Doechii and actress Tessa Thompson. title: Dubai: Stablecoin USD1 Picked for $2 Billion MGX Investment
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: The stablecoin USD1 was chosen by MGX, an AI and cutting-edge technology investor based in Abu Dhabi, for investment in the cryptocurrency exchange Binance. The news broke last month that MGX will invest $2 billion in Binance, the biggest investment in a cryptocurrency startup to date. Zach Witkoff, a co-founder of the Trump family’s decentralised financial system World Liberty Financial (WLF), announced in Dubai. On stage at the Token2049 Dubai, he was accompanied by Justin Sun, a Chinese-born cryptocurrency millionaire who invented the cryptocurrency TRON, and Eric Trump. Madinat Jumeirah hosted the event on April 30 and May 1. The event brought together over 15,000 individuals from the crypto sector to network and share ideas through more than 500 side sessions. It is one of several international conferences scheduled to take place in various locations worldwide. Three UAE businesses declared earlier this week that a stablecoin backed by the dirham will be launched. The Central Bank of the United Arab Emirates (CBUAE) will oversee the stablecoin, which IHC, ADQ, and First Abu Dhabi Bank support. After regulatory clearances, the nation’s biggest bank, FAB, will issue the stablecoin. According to the UAE companies, the dirham-backed stablecoin is intended to facilitate payments in a future where value, identity, and governance are all freely, safely, and verifiably exchanged. Businesses, organisations, and people alike will utilise this stablecoin as a dependable digital money in a variety of real-world situations.   • Online retailers with thousands of SKUs.

Ideal for:

E-commerce firms looking to expand outside DIY platforms.

How to Select the Right Software Agency in Germany?

Not all development shops are made equal. Here’s how to prevent frequent outsourcing mistakes:

  • Know Your Priorities

Is it speed? Budget? Scalability? UX? Choose your top two and proceed accordingly.

  • Assess Communication Skills

Many German agencies speak English fluently—but always test communication during discovery conversations.

  • Review Previous Work

Don’t depend just on their portfolio. Enquire about case studies, client references, or perhaps a tiny trial project.

  • Consider time zone and cultural fit

German agencies often operate on CET and have established work environments, which is ideal for predictability and meeting deadlines.

At first look, Germany may appear to be too conservative or sluggish for today’s fast-paced technological environment. But here’s a twist: That discipline, structure, and “measure twice, cut once” approach are exactly what make their software development firms so reliable.

These aren’t suppliers who leave after the debut. These are partners—teams that prioritise quality, user experience, business objectives, and long-term sustainability. Whether you’re establishing a SaaS platform, digitising outdated procedures, or developing the next big mobile app, a German software studio is eager to collaborate.

And, with a global perspective, multinational workforce, and real technological firepower, they’re more than prepared to take on your next major project.

title: Ghibli Effect: ChatGPT Usage Achieves a Record with the Deployment of Viral Functionality
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: The frenzy to make Ghibli-style AI art with ChatGPT’s image-generation tool resulted in a record number of users for OpenAI’s chatbot last week, straining its infrastructure and momentarily limiting the feature’s use. The viral fad saw users from all over the world fill social media with images modelled on the hand-drawn style of the iconic Japanese animation business, Studio Ghibli, founded by renowned director Hayao Miyazaki and known for films such as “Spirited Away” and “My Neighbour Totoro. We added one million people in the previous hour,” OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in an X post on Monday, comparing it to the one million users added in five days following ChatGPT’s explosive launch more than two years ago. According to SensorTower statistics, active users, in-app subscription revenue, and app downloads hit an all-time high last week after the AI business released improvements to its GPT-4o model, enabling advanced picture generating capabilities. According to the market intelligence organisation, global app downloads and weekly active users on the ChatGPT app jumped 11% and 5%, respectively, from the previous week, while in-app purchase income increased by 6%. title: An Abu Dhabi-Backed Investor Invests $2 Billion in Cryptocurrency on Binance.
author: Entrepreneur Mirror
excerpt: The firms announced on Wednesday that MGX, an investment organization supported by Abu Dhabi, has invested $2 billion in Binance, strengthening the relationship between the UAE and the biggest cryptocurrency exchange in the world. The transaction, which Binance referred to as its first institutional investment, is among the biggest in the cryptocurrency sector’s history. After investing in stablecoin, a cryptocurrency based on a fiat currency like the dollar, MGX will become a minority shareholder. A Binance representative declined to comment on “the agreed governance rights,” the amount of MGX’s stake, and the stablecoin utilized for the investment. After capitalizing on the growing demand for trading bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, Binance, which was established in 2017 in China by billionaire Changpeng Zhao, became the largest cryptocurrency exchange globally. Richard Teng, CZ’s successor and a former head of Abu Dhabi’s Financial Services Authority, has strengthened the exchange’s ties with the United Arab Emirates. In its announcement on Wednesday, Binance stated that it had a “substantial footprint” in the United Arab Emirates, where it employs approximately 1,000 of its 5,000 employees. MGX, which was founded over a year ago “to accelerate the development and adoption of AI and advanced technologies” through partnerships, announced its first public cryptocurrency venture with the investment in Binance.
